data.spiritual_meaning: A protector and defender against evil.
data.etymology: Khaldoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khaldoon total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: خالدون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من خلد، يعبر عن طول العمر و البقاء
in_arabic.long_meaning: خالدون هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل خلد الذي يعني البقاء و الدوام، و هو اسم يدل على طول العمر و البقاء في الخير و السعادة، و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَا يُعَمَرُ مِنَ الْمُكَذِبِينَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا'، و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في التراث الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: خالدون
in_urdu.meaning: خلد سے مشتق، عمر کی لمبائی اور بقاء کا اظہار کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: خالدون ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بقاء اور دوام، یہ نام عمر کی لمبائی اور خیر و خوشی میں بقاء کی علامت ہے، عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، اور اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وَمَا يُعَمَرُ مِنَ الْمُكَذِبِينَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا'، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے.

in_hindi.name: खालदून
in_hindi.meaning: खलद से व्युत्पन्न, जीवन की लंबाई और शाश्वतता को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: खालदून एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शाश्वतता और स्थायित्व, यह नाम जीवन की लंबाई और सुख-शांति में शाश्वतता का प्रतीक है, अरबी मूल से व्युत्पन्न यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखता है, और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी आया है, जैसे कि 'وَمَا يُعَمَرُ مِنَ الْمُكَذِبِينَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا', यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है.

in_pashto.name: خالدون
in_pashto.meaning: د خلد څخه مشتق، د عمر د اوږدولو او پاتې کیدو څرګندونه کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: خالدون یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یی دایمي او دوامدار دی، دا نوم د عمر د اوږدولو او په خیر او خوښۍ کې د پاتې کیدو نښه ده، د عربی ریشه لرونکی دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې مهم دی، او په قرآن کریم کې یې ذکر شوی دی، لکه 'وَمَا يُعَمَرُ مِنَ الْمُكَذِبِينَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا'.

in_english.name: Khaldoon
in_english.meaning: Eternal, immortal, long-lived, derived from Arabic root 'khalada'
in_english.long_meaning: Khaldoon is a masculine given name originating from Arabic, derived from the root 'khalada' which means to be eternal or to last long, it symbolizes long life and perpetuity in goodness and happiness, referenced in the Quran, specifically in 'وَمَا يُعَمَرُ مِنَ الْمُكَذِبِينَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا', signifying the brief lifespan of disbelievers, in Islamic tradition, this name holds significant spiritual and cultural value, representing a desirable trait of enduring faith and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khaldoon holds a great cultural significance for Muslim communities, particularly those with Arabic roots. In Arabic, the name Khaldoon is derived from the Arabic word "khald" which means power or strength. This name is popular among Arab families due to its significance and the admiration for strength and power in their culture. The name Khaldoon represents courage, bravery, and resilience, traits that are valued in many Muslim societies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Khaldoon holds a deeper meaning for Muslims. In the Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is believed to have said that the strong believer is better than the weak one, but both are dear to Allah (Subhanahu wa Ta'ala, or Glorified is He). This hadith highlights the importance of spiritual strength and determination, emphasizing that physical strength is only one aspect of a person's character. Therefore, the name Khaldoon is not just a symbol of physical power, but also represents spiritual strength and submission to Allah. Being called Khaldoon serves as a reminder to the person to strive for both physical and spiritual strength, and to use their power and abilities in the service of Allah and the betterment of society.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Khaldoon means "the possessor of goodness and generosity" in Arabic. It symbolizes the idea of abundance and bestowal, reflecting the divine attribute of Allah as the Giver and Provider.

historical_references.context: Khalid ibn al-Walid (592-642 AD) is considered one of the greatest military commanders in Islamic history. He is often referred to as the 'Sword of Allah' due to his impressive military victories. Khalid played a crucial role in the early Islamic conquests, particularly in the campaigns against the Byzantine and Persian empires.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Caliph Umar ibn Abdulaziz - Patron of Scholars and the Name 'Khaldoon' The name Khaldoon carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Caliph Umar ibn Abdulaziz (682-720 AD) was a well-known patron of scholars. During his reign, the name 'Khaldoon' became popular. It is believed to have originated from the name of a famous companion of the Prophet Muhammad, Khalid ibn al-Walid, as a sign of respect and admiration for his military prowess and leadership qualities.
